d:
Jahaan Main Jaati Hoon is a timelessly playful Golden Era duet from Chori Chori (1956), sung by Lata Mangeshkar & Manna Dey, composed by Shankar-Jaikishan with witty poetry by Shailendra, picturised on the iconic Raj Kapoor & Nargis. Pure vintage magic.
Jahaan Main Jaati Hoon Wahin Chale Aate Ho - Chori Chori | Raj Kapoor, Nargis | Manna Dey, Lata M
Song : Jahaan Main Jaati Hoon Wahin Chale Aate Ho
Movie : Chori Chori (1956)
Star Cast : Raj Kapoor, Nargis
Singers : Manna Dey, Lata Mangeshkar
Music Director : Shankar Jaikishan
Lyricist : Shailendra
